audience_fit: Home cooks making dumplings or ravioli in batches, especially when reusing the same cooking water or keeping it for sauce.
buying_objection: If you drain a whole pot at once, a colander may be more practical. Check the basket against your smallest pot and allow room for the angled handle in your drawer. Fine bits may slip through a coil basket.
